messages.author: Tero Rautalanka
messages.text: Morning Anneli. Battery alarm on this unit since the mains break last night. Mains is back but the alarm won't clear.

messages.author: Anneli Akku
messages.text: How long has mains been back?

messages.author: Anneli Akku
messages.text: Then I'd give it more time first. After a deep discharge the batteries can take most of a working day to get back on float, and the alarm usually stays until they do. Measure the string voltage now and again in two hours. If it isn't rising, I'd suspect a weak string and that's when we order new ones.

messages.author: Tero Rautalanka
messages.text: OK, measuring now. Will check back at ten.

messages.author: Tero Rautalanka
messages.text: String voltage is up by about a volt since eight.

messages.author: Anneli Akku
messages.text: That sounds healthy. Leave it be, the alarm should clear by itself later today.
